# --force reruns targets that haven't changed, without the cache: those run
# by default, and explicit ones when named.
bit
bit
grep '\Ax\z' implicit.txt
! exists specified.txt

bit --force
grep '\Axx\z' implicit.txt

bit specified
bit specified
grep '\Ax\z' specified.txt

bit --force specified
grep '\Axx\z' specified.txt

-- BUILD.bit --
implicit = exec {
  command = "printf x >> implicit.txt"
  outputs = "implicit.txt"
  inputs = []
}

explicit specified = exec {
  command = "printf x >> specified.txt"
  outputs = "specified.txt"
  inputs = []
}
